To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the fully charged 60 Ah lithium ion batteries with no safety valves experience a stable combustion process and a long time interval from ignition to thermal runaways under the external heat flux of 10–15 kW m 2.

the fire behaviors of the 60 Ah Li-ion batteries with no safety valves are characterized and the results can be used to improve battery safety design and to provide reference for fire safety engineering.
the fully charged large format Li ion battery with no safety valve will have a stable combustion stage and the combustion process can last more than 200 s.

the fire behaviors of the large format lithium ion batteries and provides a better understanding of the thermal runaway of lithium ion batteries.
the thermal runaway behaviors of large format LiFePO 3 /graphite batteries and provides useful information for the safety evaluation and early warning of the large format batteries.

a better understanding of the fire behaviors for large format lithium ion batteries and the results can be used to improve the fire safety and thermal management of lithium ion batteries in practical application.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the fully charged large format lithium ion batteries with no safety valves are vulnerable to thermal runaway and should be treated with caution.
the fully charged LiFePO 3 /graphite battery with no safety valve can be ignited by external heat flux and experience a stable combustion with a small scale fire.
large format Li-ion battery can have a stable combustion stage and it takes 201 s for fully charged battery to thermal runaway under the incident heat flux of about 11.1kW m 2.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the fire behavior of large format Li ion batteries is more complex than small format Li ion batteries and the fire behaviors of the large format Li ion battery should be evaluated and analyzed in detail.
the fire behaviors of the 60 Ah Li-ion batteries can be predicted and controlled by the incident heat flux, the battery SOC, and the battery safety valve.
the thermal runaway of LiFePO 3 /graphite batteries is a complex and gradual process.

the fire behaviors of LiFePO 3 /graphite batteries are different from the conventional lithium ion batteries.
the thermal runaway of the large format lithium ion batteries can be divided into three stages, namely ignition, stable combustion and explosion.
